chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Sallam al-Ju'fi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about faith, so he said: 'Faith is that Allah is obeyed and not disobeyed.'
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of faith according to Imam al-Sadiq in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this concise definition from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizes the practical dimension of faith, aligning with the Shia scholarly tradition that views iman as inseparable from amal (action) rather than mere verbal affirmation. This hadith underscores the concept of 'Taqwa' as the tangible manifestation of belief, where obedience to God's commands and avoidance of His prohibitions serve as the definitive proof of one's faith. It reflects the broader theological discourse on the relationship between belief and deeds, central to Shia jurisprudence and theology.
